title: Intercom Review (2026)
intro: Intercom is evaluated here as a WhatsApp Business / customer messaging platform — Intercom is an AI-first customer messaging and shared-inbox platform: Messenger, tickets, help center and Fin AI Agent on Essential/Advanced/Expert seats. First-party pricing on intercom.com/pricing (checked 2026-08-17) publishes Essential $29, Advanced $85 and Expert $132 per seat/month (annual toggle), with Fin from $0.99 per resolution outcome on all plans; Copilot $29/agent/mo and Proactive Support Plus $99/mo add-ons; email/SMS/WhatsApp/Phone are pay-as-you-go channels. Free trial documented. CS-borderline — primary business-communications landscape with secondary customer-service taxonomy. Scored in customer-messaging; never ranked as a phone peer. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s business-communications methodology (ease of use, voice/messaging quality, routing and workflows, integrations, analytics, outbound tools, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Intercom when you need an AI-first customer messaging inbox with Fin resolutions — especially for in-app Messenger CS — not when you only need a marketing chatbot or a business phone.
verdict: Choose Intercom when you need an AI-first customer messaging inbox with Fin resolutions — especially for in-app Messenger CS — not when you only need a marketing chatbot or a business phone. Compare respond.io for WhatsApp-first omnichannel support, ManyChat for marketing DM automation, Zendesk/helpdesks when ticketing is primary, and Talkdesk when the purchase is true CCaaS. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Messenger + shared inbox are polished for support teams; seat/Fin/add-on commercial complexity adds buying friction. Score from documented packaging, not lab testing.
Scored on customer messaging (live chat, Messenger, help center) — strong CS conversation quality. Phone/SMS/WhatsApp exist as paygo channels, not as the core scored surface.
Team inboxes, workflows, round-robin and SLAs (Advanced/Expert) are a primary strength versus marketing chatbots.
Salesforce/HubSpot/Shopify/Slack and Fin-on-helpdesk paths give broad CS integration gravity.
Pre-built reports on Essential with deeper ops analytics on higher plans — strong mid/high CS analytics.
Proactive Support Plus and Series campaigns cover outbound CS; not a marketing-broadcast specialist like ManyChat — mid outbound.
Expert multibrand, SSO and Fin automation document clear mid-market to enterprise CS scale.
Published $29 Essential helps, but Fin outcomes + channel paygo + Copilot add-ons make real TCO expensive versus ManyChat/Wati. Affiliate economics excluded.
Fin AI Agent from $0.99/outcome is among the strongest CS AI packages in this catalogue — high AI with usage commercial caveat.

faq.question: Is Intercom a business phone system?
faq.answer: No. Intercom is a WhatsApp Business / customer messaging platform. If you need IVR, queues and PSTN calling, pair it with a cloud phone system such as Aircall, CallHippo, KrispCall or Freshcaller.

faq.question: How is Intercom priced?
faq.answer: Essential $29, Advanced $85, Expert $132 per seat/month (annual toggle) confirmed on intercom.com/pricing 2026-08-17; Fin from $0.99/outcome; Copilot $29/agent/mo; Proactive Support Plus $99/mo. Channel messaging pay-as-you-go. High confidence on seat + Fin floors.

faq.question: Does Intercom have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Intercom?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
